scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p src/physics-core/wasm && em++ src/physics-core/cpp/src/*.cpp src/physics-core/cpp/bindings.cpp -I src/physics-core/cpp/include -o src/physics-core/wasm/physics.js --bind -sMODULARIZE=1 -sEXPORT_ES6=1 -sENVIRONMENT=web,worker,node
scripts.test:physics: mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Werror src/physics-core/add.cpp src/physics-core/test.cpp -o build/physics-core-test && build/physics-core-test
